features.drawer_desc: [tw] A sleek, stowable roster interface. Fully event-driven for real-time status updates without the lag.
features.compass_desc: [tw] Track players in maps or normal rooms! Hovering cards, chat names, or characters reveals a spinning 3D indicator and halo glow.
features.chat_desc: [tw] Highlights messages containing your name or custom words. Includes color matching, auto-capitalization, and exclusion phrases to prevent false positives.
features.privacy_desc: [tw] A customizable "boss key" that instantly blanks the character screen or game window. Toggle via keybind (Default: CTRL + ALT + B).
features.performance_desc: [tw] Monitors true frame delta. Dynamically lowers visual quality and update rates to save your FPS during lag spikes.
features.blindness_desc: [tw] Optional roster blurring based on your blindness level. Fully respects BCX "Full Blind" rules.
features.colors_desc: [tw] Automatically detects dark or muddy player name colors and applies a high-contrast outline for readability.
features.whisper_desc: [tw] Send whispers in map rooms at any distance. Auto-elevates to a beep if a friend leaves the room before you send.

commands.roster_desc: [tw] Opens the enhanced roster in the chat log. Shows detailed information about everyone in the room.
commands.arg_count: [tw] Only shows current room population counters.
commands.arg_banner: [tw] Force redraws the room information banner.
commands.whisper_desc: [tw] Global whisper system for map rooms. Bypass range restrictions to message anyone on the map.
commands.dropkeys_desc: [tw] Instantly drop specific keys (bronze, silver, gold) or all keys at once.

interactions.click_badge: [tw] Click Badge: Opens the character's focus screen.
interactions.click_name: [tw] Click Player's Name: Start a Whisper+ message.
interactions.click_id: [tw] Click Number (ID): Copies the player's member number to your clipboard.
interactions.live_sorting: [tw] Live Sorting: Use the top-right dropdown in the drawer to sort players by Roles, D/s Family, Lovers, or Friends.
interactions.reverse_hover: [tw] Reverse Hover: Hovering a character in the game world highlights their card in the roster.
interactions.shortcuts: [tw] Keyboard Shortcuts: CTRL + ALT + D toggles the drawer. CTRL + ALT + B toggles Privacy Mode.

status.indicators_desc: [tw] Status Indicators: Every card features three icons indicating if a player is Gagged, Blind, or Deaf. These light up and display severity levels when hovered.

settings_guide.intro:
[tw] Access settings via the {icon} icon in the drawer, now featuring a fully tabbed interface.
Quick Chat Return: Click the Chat Bubble Icon in the top right to instantly return to the game.
settings_guide.general_update: [tw] Update Notifications: Alerts you when to refresh for a new version.
settings_guide.general_banner: [tw] Show Banner on Entry: Displays an info banner when joining a room.
settings_guide.general_privacy: [tw] Full-Screen Privacy Mode: Blanks the entire screen instead of just the chat side when the hotkey is used.
settings_guide.general_halo: [tw] Enable Focus Halo: Shows a pulsing halo effect on hovered avatars.
settings_guide.general_keybinds: [tw] Edit Keybinds: Direct shortcut to the game's keybinding menu to change your Privacy and Drawer toggle hotkeys.
settings_guide.drawer_enable: [tw] Enable Drawer UI: Turns the sliding drawer interface on or off.
settings_guide.drawer_toggle_cmd: [tw] /roster toggles drawer: Typing /roster or /crabs opens the drawer instead of printing in chat.
settings_guide.drawer_tab: [tw] Show Drawer Tab: Toggles the persistent visual tab on the screen edge.
settings_guide.drawer_logo_anim: [tw] Animated Tab Logo: Toggle the drawer logo animation to save performance.
settings_guide.drawer_compact: [tw] Compact Height: Limits the drawer to 77% height, keeping the chat input visible.
settings_guide.drawer_autostow: [tw] Auto-stow Options: Close the drawer automatically after sending a standard chat or Whisper+.
settings_guide.drawer_focus: [tw] Focus Follows Mouse: Automatically switch to a player's page when hovering their card.
settings_guide.drawer_autoscroll: [tw] Auto-Scroll Drawer: The roster automatically scrolls to the character you are mousing over in the game world.
settings_guide.immersion_lock: [tw] Hardcore Lock: Locks these immersion settings ON while your character is bound.
settings_guide.immersion_blind_gag: [tw] Respect Blindness & Gags: Blurs the roster UI and disables Whisper+ based on character state.
settings_guide.immersion_bcx: [tw] Respect BCX Rules: Enforces BCX restrictions within the CRABS interface.
settings_guide.maps_compass: [tw] Show Map Compass: Displays a directional arrow on the map.
settings_guide.maps_superzoom: [tw] SuperZoom: Unlocks the game's default map zoom limitations (auto-disables if conflicts are detected).
settings_guide.chat_mentions: [tw] Highlight Mentions: Alerts you when specific words or your name are spoken. Customize the highlight color.
settings_guide.chat_caps_match: [tw] Auto-Capitalize & Color Match: Capitalizes your name and matches it to your character's label color in highlights.
settings_guide.chat_custom_words: [tw] Custom Words & Exclusion Phrases: Add trigger words and use wildcards (e.g., 'pick* a rose') to prevent false alarms.
settings_guide.chat_links: [tw] Chat Log Hover Links: Hovering names in the chat log triggers the focus halo and map compass.
settings_guide.chat_whisper_elevate: [tw] Whisper+ Auto-elevate: Attempts to send a Whisper+ as a standard beep if a friend leaves the room.
settings_guide.config_cloud_sync: [tw] Disable Cloud Sync: Keeps settings strictly local, preventing cross-device syncing. Includes a capacity tracker.
settings_guide.config_delete_server: [tw] Delete Server Save: Wipes your CRABS settings from the game server.
settings_guide.config_export_import: [tw] Export / Import: Copy or paste your settings string to backup or share.
